title: Number of Ways to Build Sturdy Brick Wall
goal: Count brick walls with no aligned internal seams in adjacent rows.
strategy: Generate every row tiling as a mask of internal seams. Two row patterns are compatible when their seam masks do not overlap; DP stacks compatible rows modulo one billion plus seven.
